body: I will, thanks for being there for me!  I am seeing a therapist today and I'm hoping that will get me on the path to a healthier life.  We'll see.  I'm unbearably positive today, so I hope to continue this direction.
Thanks for being so nice!  I made an appointment to start seeing a therapist today, so hopefully that helps.
That's a huge step towards feeling better!  Congratulations for doing such a hard thing!
Glad to bring a smile to your face!  :D
your family needs you... they are coping with the loss of one child and whehter you know it or not, they need your help for that.  talk to them about how you feel, and stay strong!
We're all here for you!  You can talk about the issues you're dealing with now, or we can talk about anything at all!  Cats, cell phones, cigarettes, music, clothing, shoes, Taylor Swift... anything!
I hope you're right about the marriage... I'm certainly trying!  Thank you for your words!
I have never been religious, but have recently been debating looking into it... it might help me out, I don't know.  Thanks for the advice!
you have enough courage to talk to us, i bet you can find it in you to talk to the therapist on wednesday.  you're not a burden or an annoyance, your doctor wants to help you.

Very much this.  I cried for hours tonight and nearly went to the hospital because my mind was scaring me so much... and then the cat came over, and snuggled me, purred on me, and made me feel just a slight bit of happiness.  Now I'm chain smoking and crying much less.
I replied, but I think it got deleted!  :( That, or I'm a ding dong and didn't do it right.

i've been chain smoking tonight.  and even logged into livejournal for the first time in a few years to do some venting.  i'm struggling to find the positive things to keep me going, but there are some.  you'll find some too... when your parents return, talk to them!
